queue.title: Announcements: large, persistent, reliably delivered
queue.notes: Backend (forgehouse50 commit c395d00, CI 41173815665 green): /api/announcements/latest & /api/announcements serve strict no-store headers, raise limits to 120/4000 chars, retain retired (status='archived') announcements in archive while removing from Today active card, support both Cookie and Bearer 64-hex auth, and provide in-memory schedule fallback for dedicated admin_credentials accounts on /api/today. queue.title: Reader timer: never show raw exception text
queue.notes: Root-caused raw 'The coroutine was canceled because it left the composition' leak in ReadScreen.kt: Kotlin runCatching blocks on day(activeDay), getPassage(), and completeDay() caught CancellationException and assigned it.message directly to UI error state rendered right beneath 'Paused. Touch screen to resume', and addReadingTime caught generic Exception without rethrowing CancellationException. Added runSuspendCatching (always rethrows CancellationException) + ReaderErrorSanitizer (strips any coroutine/network/JVM exception markers and enforces clean pauseBannerText) in ReadingTimerEngine.kt, audited and hardened ReadScreen, QuizScreen, TranslationsScreen, NotesScreens, and AuthScreens, added BundledFootnoteListSerializer on Verse.footnotes, and added testCoroutineCancellationNeverEmitsRawExceptionText in ReadingTimerEngineTest.kt.

queue.title: Rest days: catch-up still allowed, closes at 7pm Lagos
queue.notes: Server (forgehouse50 commit c0da599) + Android enforced: on Tuesdays and Fridays (rest days), members with missed past days (scheduledDate < todayStr in Africa/Lagos) can read & complete catch-up (max 2 days/session, oldest first, 0 streak credit) until rest_day_catchup_cutoff_time (default 19:00 Africa/Lagos), after which /api/today & /api/read/complete close catch-up with 'Catch-up closes at 7pm today for Bible Study, continue tomorrow.' Normal/future reading stays locked on rest days and normal reading days remain unrestricted all day. Added Admin Programme tab cutoff editor + SQLite & JUnit tests.

queue.title: Streak verification (verify first, fix only if wrong)
queue.notes: Root-caused and fixed Oct 18 'Streak 0 while reading daily' server bug in functions/lib/points.mjs (forgehouse50 commit 04d9fb4, CI 41176970742 green): (1) streaks() previously checked highestCompleted < elapsedDays(today), which falsely reset every active daily reader's current streak to 0 at 00:00 WAT on every scheduled reading day before they completed today's reading; changed inactivity check to strictly past uncompleted reading days (r.date < today) so active streaks remain alive throughout today and grow +1 upon on-time completion (verified live on consistency leaderboard: active daily readers now show current=12, 6, 2 instead of 0 on Saturday morning, while Section 5 screenshot user with 7/50 on Day 13 correctly remains 0). (2) Fixed longest streak calculation so catch-up days (compDate > sched) never add to longest or current streak. (3) Added Cache-Control: no-store + deterministic NOW_MS support on /api/progress and /api/auth/me, plus 6-scenario SQLite D1 suite in test/streak_test.mjs.
